replies.content: Just repeated it during the day and got some marvelous 6.86 Mbps down and 0.56 Mbps up ⚡️ It’s definitely light speed. The worst part is that the Internet provider has had fiber in the town for years now. But first it was just for companies and now it’s just in some streets. We’re talking about a very small town (less than 500 people), adding cables wouldn’t be that much work.
